description: A coin's recent news, labelled by Asrai: each headline with date, event type (listing, hack, ETF, upgrade, lawsuit, unlock…) and impact (good/bad/neutral). Key events only by default — breaking channel news + major outlets. Use for 'what happened to X', 'why did X move', 'any news on X'. Lighter than coin_info.

all.description: true = every headline, not only key events
